梦汐 API accounts are optional and provided by api.huanyan.fun. Only when you register, sign in, sign out, refresh or sync does the app contact that platform, sending the username, password, email, verification code, optional invitation code, account access token or refresh cookie required by the selected operation. Passwords are not saved. User information, session cookies and API Keys are stored locally; account sessions are excluded from app backups and Android backup/transfer. Primary and secondary model Keys are exported only when you enable secrets in a backup. Account sync never uploads local conversations, attachments or other settings. When you use this model service, the model request content is sent directly to the platform under its own agreement and privacy policy. Signing out clears the local account session and attempts to revoke that session; model services and Keys remain until you remove them.
